name: excontrol
description: eXcontrol — a simple web control overlay for LED installations (NovaStar H-series / COEX, Expromo EPS, OBS)

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace backend & npm run dev --workspace frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.desktop:start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run dist --workspace desktop
